mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or the average 20-day return in such instances is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.5%, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction starts above 1.5 million units signals strong household demand and rising inflationary pressure, leading to a higher probability of Fed rate hikes and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1500.0, or the average return in such instances is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 112.0 indicates weakening real economic activity, which triggers a shift in market expectations toward a recession, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 112.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both consumer spending (RSAFS) and residential construction (HOUST) signals strong aggregate demand, which increases inflation expectations and raises the likelihood of Fed rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST are above their 12-month moving averages, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a rapidly tightening labor market, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.5% combined with a stable federal funds rate signals that inflation is outpacing policy response, increasing the risk of future rate hikes and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 205.0 and FEDFUNDS is ≤5.5%, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) combined with a rising GDP growth rate (GDPC1) signals strong underlying demand, which increases the probability of Fed rate hikes and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both RSAFS and GDPC1 are above their 12-month moving averages, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
